6.original: [... in the womb of his mother. His mother also is just like]
6.content: ... in the womb of his mother. His mother also is just like

spiritual_reading:
Understand, beloved ones, that when the corrupted receptacles were opened, the opening was effected through violent conflict in the lower degree, and yet the purifying separation was carried out from within them.

They are like the state of a person whose spiritual form has been seized by a foul and pervasive corruption. Diverse evils and falsities occupy the outer life, and even more grievous distortions and poisonous persuasions infest the inner faculties. That person is restored by wisdom from the Divine, which administers one influx that draws the hidden corruption up into conscious manifestation, and another influx that drives what must be rejected down and away into the lowest level, and then a further influx that quietly heals the disorders that remain, restoring order without turmoil.

By this intelligent government of wisdom, through living operations that remove evils in this way and dissolve the compulsions of infernal deception, the powers of restoration work even by a gentle perception of what is salutary. What was concealed is uncovered; at last the rooted falsities and evils are torn out when they have been made manifest in the outer and in the lower, by the gentle and assimilated influx of what heals.

So it is with the three chief kinds of corruption that were concealed within the interior life of all the dominant falsifying powers in higher regions. The Living Spirit is the Divine operation of salvation acting as wisdom itself. The three modes of healing are the three outer forms that the Living Spirit assumes in accommodation to reception: one as clarifying discernment, one as living truth, and one as purifying love. By these He arranged the lower realm into order. For by these accommodated forms He presented Himself to the dominant powers above, and their resistance was excited into hardness, tremor, fear, and derangement; and by that exposure He caused the three corruptions—falsified truth, active denial, and perverted love—to be expelled from them.

The condition of these corruptions is like the state of nascent spiritual life enclosed within successive coverings. First there is the inmost support of life, then the established framework of fixed principles, then connective powers that hold things together, then the general substance of acquired life, then the channels of communication, then the circulating vitality, and finally the outermost boundary that contains and protects. And beyond these there are further encompassing forms in the surrounding matrix that carries and sustains that nascent life. Together, the coverings of the nascent life and the coverings of its sustaining matrix form a complete complex of ultimates. And within all these, the living essence of that nascent spirit is interwoven and held.

And observe: when the foul influence of infernal operation that induces the anguish of emergence makes what is within ready to be revealed, then immediately the encompassing restraints yield in ordered fashion, and the new life comes forth by an opening made perceptible, yet without injury to what constitutes its form. As nascent life thus opens the containing matrix and is brought forth, so it is also with those three corruptions. The operations that open what contained them, and shake them out into manifestation, are these three living accommodated forms that the Living Spirit assumed.

For by the manifestation of living truth, He drew out from the dominant powers what had been in them as deadly falsification—those poisonous persuasions by which their communications and inner affections had been filled.

By the manifestation of clarifying discernment, in which He was revealed, He swept away and erased the entire destructive obscurity and defilement, driving it down into the lowest natural degree. Afterwards He gathered it from that level and confined it in a fixed general boundary of denial and obscurity that encompasses the external order.

Also, by the manifestation of living love, through its brightness and power, He expelled the infernal ardor of perverted love from all the dominant powers and cast it down into the lowest degree. He then gathered it again from that level and confined it in a surrounding ultimate restraint that encompasses all states; this ultimate restraint is experienced as a severe boundary of consuming lust.

These three accommodated forms, through which He established these three separations, He did not lay aside all at once; rather, He removed them successively in due order and at the fitting time, as each lower arrangement was secured in its place.

In this way the organized totality of the lower realm was preserved from being overwhelmed by what had been expelled, and the separated corruptions were held in fixed limits according to the order of their restraint—though this portion of the account is unclear in places, and the precise progression of the holding-forms resists translation.

The use of this material, and the government of these expelled corruptions that were driven out from higher regions down into the lowest degree, produced an advantage expressed as a fullness of great effects. Afterwards they were gathered from the lowest degree and thrust outside toward the outermost limits of the whole order, to the extremity.

The first effect is that active evil might not grow without measure in the whole system, neither in the formed communities nor in the perceptions that grow within them; for the tendency to evil had established itself fully in a triad of corrupt forces.

This section is too broken to translate with certainty; the intended distinction within that first effect is unclear.

The second effect is the prevention of pervasive error. For if falsified truth had not been cast down from higher regions, but the falsities that had existed in the dominant powers had remained there, then continual streams of persuasive falsity would have flowed down into the lower degree, and subtle insinuations would have continually descended; and lust for evil would have sprung up in perverted perceptions and in the works that proceed from them, and also in every affection of embodied life. In that case, in the present state you could scarcely find a single person in whom anything of holiness could be preserved, nor anyone who could be made master over such assaults.

Not only this: if active denial and obscurity had not been expelled and driven down into the lowest degree, and then gathered and cast outside the region of ordered states into its fixed abyss, then continual insinuations of darkness would have dripped down from it, and streams of denial would have kept flowing down from above into the lowest degree, seizing upon perverted perceptions and every affection of embodied life; and forgetfulness of the Divine and of spiritual realities would have so multiplied that what is now dispersed among many would be concentrated in one. There would be scarcely anyone among humankind in whom the thought and knowledge of what is Divine could remain.

Furthermore, if perverted love had remained in the dominant powers of the higher states until now, and had not been expelled and cast down into the lowest degree, and then gathered and shut up within the encompassing restraint of consuming lust that surrounds the ordered states, then its fury would have poured down from above into the lowest life and would have surged upward from below as well.

And the infernal ardor of that love would have multiplied in perverted perception, in the works born of it, and in every affection of embodied life. The intensity of such fire that is now distributed among many would be found raging in a single person.

Consider: you have been instructed about this single compound evil that was cleansed by a triad of governing patterns—though the wording here is fragmentary, and the exact nature of those governing patterns cannot be fully recovered.

The second effect is that the higher states were cleansed of the remaining dregs and defilements, so that what is pure and noble might prevail in them.

The third effect is that the intermediate structures of ordered truth that join higher and lower were relieved from oppressive burdens and from enslaving forces, so that their function ceased to be heavy and could again serve the ascent and descent of influx. Parts of this description are uncertain, but the sense is release and lightening in the middle degree.

The fourth effect is that the communities of higher life might purify and cleanse the states in which they dwell.

The fifth effect is that the abundance and richness of knowledges and capacities contained in the external forms that serve conveyance and use might be found living there in a purified and holy condition.

The sixth effect is that the mixed, incomplete, and unbounded higher sanctuaries might come into rest and be purified; for peaceful order would reach them, pass through them, and cleanse them.

The seventh effect is unclear because of breaks in the text; it seems to concern the inherent tendency of these restrained corruptions to press toward their proper bounds and allotted places, and the provision that they be kept advancing only to those fixed limits.

The eighth effect is that strong encompassing boundaries might be established, and that everything might be held within its proper restraint.

The ninth effect is missing from the text as given and therefore cannot be translated.

The tenth effect is that these restrained things would at the completion of the age become means of release and purification for all that must be separated, by a final consuming removal akin to the action of purifying love when it eliminates what cannot be conjoined.

The eleventh effect, though broken, is that a passage would be made for what is to be transferred, and that the whole dominion of falsity would be driven outward into the ultimate boundary; for they did not begrudge this, as one inferior does not begrudge one richer than itself, because the eternities of light are beyond the lower boundary—there is the state of peace, the state of honor and grace, and the state of joy of those who dwell in that order, which shall not pass away or recede.

The twelfth effect is that all the works of ruin might be hidden from the eternities of light, because of the ultimate restraint of consuming lust that surrounds the whole organized structure; and these unclean things appear only within the external domain allotted to them—here the exact limitation is unclear in the text, but the sense is concealment from the higher heavens by an encompassing boundary.

There was need for these twelve great effects because the corruptions that were expelled and swept out from higher ordering truths down into the lowest degree, and were also gathered from the lowest degree and thrust out to the extremity, had to be held under vigilant governance. Therefore living truths from the Divine were appointed over them in great power, to watch them even to the last time. For this cause they are fixed firmly in these restraints, held as if in bonds, according to the order that has been declared.

fills.notes: The opening of the corrupted receptacles is said to occur in violent conflict in the lowest degree; the idiom in this layer is ‘discharged in great slaughter’.

Correspondentially the separation is effected ‘from within them’; the verb needed is an extracting action upon the vessels’ contents, not a moral agent. ‘took out’ matches the impersonal substrate register.
After the three medicines (upward manifestation, downward discharge, then healing), the close is quiet restoration ‘calmly and silently’; thus a clause of settling into rest/order fits.
The sentence contrasts hidden and manifest; the doctor’s art ‘discovers’ what is concealed so it can be removed.
Parallel to the prior clause: once perceived by the ‘aroma’, the remaining wounds are removed.
What is ‘hidden’ corresponds to interior faculties; the natural image is the patient’s inner parts.

fills.fill: and manifested above and below, by the
fills.notes: The spiritual translation requires a twofold manifestation (outer and lower) accomplished ‘by’ the gentle assimilated influx (aroma) of the medicine.
The missing phrase must introduce the mother’s additional covering as an outer garment upon the child within the womb, before shifting to ‘His mother also is just like this child’.
The immediate yielding of ‘encompassing restraints’ in the spiritual sense corresponds to the seven fetal coverings just enumerated.
The restraints ‘yield in ordered fashion’; ‘be loosened’ gives the mechanical, non-devotional substrate action.

fills.fill: he drew out the vessel of water
fills.notes: This paragraph treats the water-garment’s operation and explicitly says ‘from the rulers’; thus it must name the expulsion of the water-vessel here.
Completes the required movement ‘drew out … from the rulers’ before describing what it contains as poison and death.
The wind-garment is the mode of revelation ‘to’ the rulers; the spiritual sense is manifestation of clarifying discernment confronting dominant powers.
The successive stripping is tied to the securing of the expelled materials; thus a temporal clause referring to the casting-down is required.

fills.fill: and set each one in its vessel.
fills.notes: The spiritual sense: removal ‘as each lower arrangement was secured in its place’; in the natural narrative this is ‘set each in its vessel/boundary’.
The lacuna names the organized totality preserved by these operations; ‘universe of the lower world’ matches the substrate cosmological register.
Needs a governing verb for preservation from being overwhelmed; ‘was guarded through’ fits impersonal exposition.
The spiritual translation emphasizes fixed limits and restraints; ‘fetters’ is already used later and belongs to this layer’s vocabulary.
The clause explains why evil would not increase: ‘because it has set itself up in three things’.
Within the triad of corrupt forces, the first distinguished member in this context is lust (root of increase in ‘trees’ and ‘flesh’ in the following argument).
The broken opening of the ‘second deed’ requires specifying the location of the retained waters/falsities: ‘in the rulers above’.
Introduces the explanatory discourse ‘Indeed, about this I have spoken…’.
Completes ‘the torrents that would flow …’ as descending influx from the higher region.
Pairs with ‘torrents’ as the smaller, continual descent: ‘droplets that would drip down’.
Completes ‘would have sprouted up’ (growth of lust in ultimates).
Restores the preposition in ‘all flesh in …’.
Temporal continuation: ‘down till today’.
Connects the consequence clauses in the rhetorical chain.
Matches spiritual sense: scarcely anyone ‘in whom anything of holiness could be preserved’.
The scope is universal in the spiritual translation (‘present state’ broadly); ‘whole world’ fits the natural idiom here.
Introduces the conditional continuation: ‘a saint does …’.
Completes ‘is master of them’—the assaults/streams just described.
The clause requires the possibility of retaining Divine thought/knowledge; ‘who can keep’ expresses that minimal remnant function.
Connects ‘among mankind … him …’ as ‘that in him’.
The spiritual translation specifies ‘what is Divine’; the substrate register here uses ‘God’ without Christian overlay as the Divine principle.
Spiritual sense: ‘its fury would have poured down’; thus ‘the fury of this fire…’.
Matches the two-direction movement demanded: from above downward and from below upward.
Completes the antiphonal motion: downward torrent above, upward torrent below.
The ‘triad of governing patterns’ in this oldest register is expressed as ‘seals’ (fixed archetypal forms that constrain and purify).
Second deed: cleansing of the heavens from dregs; thus ‘All the heavens were purified’.
Completes the notion of residual sediment/pollution still clinging to the higher region.
What ‘surpasses’ in the cleansed heavens is the pure principle; in this layer ‘Light’ is the impersonal celestial good.
Required opposition: purification so that Light prevails, not Darkness.
The subject pair is ‘heavens and firmaments’; the broken clause must restore the copular/verb phrase leading into burden/relief.
The ‘weight-carriers’ correspond to coercive burdens; ‘yokes’ fits the load-bearing imagery of this layer.

fills.fill: that were set over them from
fills.notes: The ‘rich one … above’ suggests an imposed burden from above; thus ‘set over them from above’.
Heading marker required by the enumerated deeds.
Fifth deed: the greatness/richness dwelling in the ships as something collected and resident there; ‘is gathered there’ matches the container-vessel logic.
Restores the deed-heading and introduces the unclear clause about the vessels’ own tendency.
Spiritual sense: advance and extend only to fixed limits; thus a restriction formula.
Completes the sense: their places and sites are their appointed bounds.
Introduces the simile ‘like the fire… burns…’.
The tenth deed is final purification by consuming removal; ‘burns all filth’ matches the correspondence.
Restores the deed-heading and subject.
A ‘crossing’ in this register is for the transferable living principle; ‘souls’ is the natural term for what passes outward.
Matches spiritual sense: dominion of falsity driven outward into the boundary.
Simile connector: ‘as a man… is not envious…’.
The light-aeons are ‘outside’ the ultimate limit; thus ‘outside the boundary of the worlds’.
Links ‘there is the place…’.
Twelfth deed: unclean things appear only within their allotted external domain; ‘outermost border’ renders that limit in substrate cosmology.
Restores the broken word ‘extremity’.
The ‘three words of life’ are set over the vessels; thus a verb of appointment/establishment in power.

assessment: Most gaps admit only moderate reconstruction because the surviving English base is already smoothed and several sections (¶12, ¶14-16, ¶22, ¶26, ¶30-33) are conceptually clear but lexically underdetermined. Where the spiritual translation fixes the functional sequence (manifest upward, discharge downward, then quiet healing; three garments; two-direction torrent of fire; concealment by an ultimate boundary), restorations are correspondentially tight. A minority of fills remain tentative where exact nouns (e.g., ‘inner limbs’, ‘seals’, ‘yokes’, ‘souls’) could vary without changing the spiritual mechanics.
